Additionally, the Jharsuguda Thermal Plant achieved a 186% rise in power sales, reflecting better availability and performance.

The petition was filed due to a claimed default of ₹68.49 crore, which dates back to September 2023. Unity Realty is a corporate guarantor for financial facilities availed by Unity Infraprojects, which faced financial difficulties leading to the current situation.
